author: Ryan Lester <hacker@linux.com>
policy: After confirming e2e-app/universal-app were the only non-docs blockers for owned-overlap ordinary dirs, retire those apps (and solely-supporting integration/size-test/material). Then unused-proof and delete ordinary overlap dirs plus hollow schematics/testing/prebuilt-themes. Do not mass-delete retained cdk*/maps/youtube/adapters/experimental. No npm publish. Pack only via node scripts/pack-library.mjs.

projects_pack_unused_proof.conclusion: No packing-path dependency on retired trees.
